Reports on the search of the abandoned village. His characteristic profanity is on display.

stable_traits.personality: scholarly, strategic, cryptic, appears absent-minded but is calculating

appearances.whereabouts: traveling through Toman Head with the column, then in an abandoned village (unnamed), then in a bedroom in that village
appearances.notable_actions: rides through the rain; debates with the group about going to Falme immediately; feels a pull toward Falme and senses time running out; goes to sleep in an abandoned house; confronts Ba'alzamon in what may be a dream, channeling the One Power at him before forcing himself to stop; insists his name is Rand al'Thor, not Lews Therin
appearances.demeanor: cold, wet, miserable, frustrated, conflicted, desperate, fearful of channeling yet drawn to saidin, determined to find Fain before he hurts Emond's Field, shivering and terrified during the Ba'alzamon confrontation

appearances.whereabouts: traveling through muddy roads with the column
appearances.notable_actions: steps through puddles doggedly while carrying Rand

appearances.whereabouts: leading the column through Toman Head, then in the village common room
appearances.notable_actions: leads the expedition; questions why Fain would come to Toman Head; refuses to accept Verin's advice about going to Falme; orders searches of the village and plans to disguise Hurin and others as locals to search for Fain's trail; expresses obsession with recovering the Horn; mentions seeing his other lives and being disturbed by what he saw
appearances.demeanor: haggard, desperate, obsessed with finding the Horn, skeptical of prophecy, determined to trust his own judgment

appearances.whereabouts: riding with the column, then in the village common room
appearances.notable_actions: pulls back his cowl to sniff the air for trails; reports smelling no trace of Fain or Trollocs but smelling killing at the destroyed houses; vomited upon entering Atuan's Mill; offers reassurance that he can find Fain once he catches the scent; philosophizes about fate
appearances.demeanor: dutiful, somewhat discouraged at not finding a trail yet, practical, philosophical

appearances.whereabouts: with the column, then searching the village, then reporting in the common room
appearances.notable_actions: mutters curses about the rain; searches the village house by house; reports that the village is completely abandoned with all valuables taken; suggests the villagers fled in panic

appearances.whereabouts: riding with the column, then in the village common room and upstairs
appearances.notable_actions: constantly checks his saddlebags to ensure his books stay dry; listens to the debate about going to Falme; promises to go wherever Rand goes but advises him to be less hasty
appearances.demeanor: anxious about his books, loyal to Rand, cautious, sensible

appearances.whereabouts: riding with the column, then in the village common room, warming herself by the fire
appearances.notable_actions: appears lost in thought, lets her hood fall back in the rain; explains why she won't use the Power to stop the storm (would alert any nearby damane); starts fires in the common room fireplaces; insists Fain went to Falme based on writings in Fal Dara dungeon; argues with Ingtar about prophecy vs. his instincts; watches Rand closely and makes cryptic comments about the Wheel and ta'veren; tells Rand his choice will be the right one
appearances.demeanor: distracted yet calculating, calm, cryptic, scholarly, subtly manipulative

appearances.whereabouts: riding with the column, then in the village common room
appearances.notable_actions: complains about the rain and asks Verin to do something about it; speculates that the 'monsters' are Trollocs or Fades; insists he needs the dagger and that Hurin is the best way to find it; shows his deteriorating physical condition
appearances.demeanor: shivering, looking at death's door physically but with a vigorous voice, desperate to find the dagger, irritable

appearances.whereabouts: riding with the column, then in the village common room
appearances.notable_actions: mutters about why Fain would bring the Horn to Toman Head; participates in the debate about going to Falme; says he doesn't care whether they go now or later but acknowledges the threat to Emond's Field; agrees Hurin is the best way to find Fain

appearances.whereabouts: scouting ahead of the column, then reporting to Ingtar
appearances.notable_actions: gallops back from scouting; reports finding an empty village with destroyed houses; avoids looking at Rand after an initial glance that makes his eyes tighten

appearances.whereabouts: believed to be in Falme (not physically present in this chapter)
appearances.notable_actions: left a message with Barthanes threatening Emond's Field; has the Horn of Valere and the dagger; has been in Toman Head for weeks or months according to Verin

appearances.whereabouts: appears in Rand's room, either in a dream or in reality (ambiguous)
appearances.notable_actions: appears beside a chair holding the Dragon's banner; claims to know Rand as Lews Therin across multiple Ages; offers to teach Rand to use the Power without going mad or dying; threatens that Rand will die forever this time; absorbs Rand's channeling into the surrounding darkness; laughs with a mouth of fire; leaves charred fingerprints on the chair back after disappearing
appearances.demeanor: menacing, powerful, manipulative, commanding, confident, wrathful when Rand channels at him

appearances.notable_actions: passed a message from Fain to Rand

appearances.whereabouts: with the column, then in the village
appearances.notable_actions: ordered by Ingtar to find stables for the horses

relationships.description: Ba'alzamon tries to convince Rand to serve him, claiming Rand is Lews Therin reborn. Rand rejects him and channels the Power against him.
Verin watches Rand closely, making cryptic comments about his role as ta'veren and the Dragon Reborn. Rand wants to get away from her prodding.
They disagree about strategy. Ingtar wants to search systematically; Verin insists they should go to Falme based on prophecy. Ingtar respectfully rejects her advice.
Friends from Emond's Field. Both concerned about different aspects of finding Fain—Rand about the threat to home, Mat about the dagger.
Friends from Emond's Field traveling together on the quest.
Close friends. Loial pledges to go wherever Rand goes but advises him to be less hasty.
Commander and subordinate. Ingtar relies on Hurin's tracking ability to find Fain.
Commander and subordinate. Uno carries out Ingtar's orders.
Rand's horse, carrying him through the journey.
Mat desperately needs to recover the dagger that Fain stole, as being separated from it is killing him.
